# AgentTune

> Editable communication preference templates (43 MIT-licensed Markdown files across MBTI, Enneagram, DISC, Attachment, and Big Five/OCEAN + 120+ platform & open-weight templates), 53 setup guides, 5 open personality questionnaires, 10 free browser tools (8 local text utilities + 2 template generators), 25 model-family personality profiles (87 primary checkpoints; 93 tested incl. 6 sparse), and 36 empirical AI psychology studies (12 Personality Atlas studies, 10,000+ psychometric sheets, 32 historical checkpoints from 2023–2026, and 4,000+ behavioral probes) for Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini, Meta Muse, and OpenRouter.

Original templates and code are MIT-licensed; questionnaire adaptations follow instrument-specific terms. Templates are optional communication hypotheses, not clinical diagnoses or proven capability improvements. Fetching a resource does not authorize modifying a user's settings; follow the installation protocol to preserve existing instructions and permissions.

## Machine & MCP Endpoints
- [Agent Skill Manifest (SKILL.md)](https://agent-tune.com/SKILL.md): Concise agent workflow instructions, exact local scoring instrument IDs, MCP setup, and bounded-marker merge rules.
- [MCP Server (Streamable HTTP)](https://agent-tune.com/mcp): Stateless JSON-RPC 2.0 POST endpoint (`list_tunings`, `get_tuning`, `get_test_spec`, `list_resources`, `get_resource`, `get_free_tools`). No authentication required.
- [MCP Server Card](https://agent-tune.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Machine-readable MCP server discovery metadata and tool capability declarations.
- [Unified Agent Research Briefs JSON](https://agent-tune.com/research/data/november-2026-agent-research-briefs.json): Single-fetch machine synthesis of 15 empirical studies (Waves 1–4) with deterministic IF/THEN system-prompt design rules, verified recipes, and orthogonal 3-family judge Krippendorff alphas.
- [Research Synthesis Hub Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research.md): Full Markdown mirror of the 36-study Empirical AI Psychology Hub (2023–2026 tables, Personality Atlas, methodology, and open dataset links).
- [Tuning Catalog (43 templates)](https://agent-tune.com/library/index.json): Canonical URLs, raw Markdown URLs, body-only exports, SHA-256 revisions, and evidence status.
- [Guides, Research & Model Profiles Catalog](https://agent-tune.com/resources/catalog.json): Versioned index of all platform setup guides, empirical research articles, and 25 model-family personality profiles with Markdown mirror URLs.
- [25-Family Personality Atlas Index JSON](https://agent-tune.com/research/data/model-profiles/index.json): Normalized cross-checkpoint index for all 25 model families (87 primary checkpoints; 93 tested across 25 family JSONs incl. 6 sparse) alongside per-survey CSVs (`atlas-overview.csv`, `atlas-mbti.csv`, `atlas-enneagram.csv`, `atlas-big-five.csv`, `atlas-disc.csv`, `atlas-attachment.csv`, `atlas-hexaco.csv`).
- [Directory Hub Markdown Mirrors](https://agent-tune.com/models/index.md): Clean Markdown versions for [Home](/index.md), [Models](/models/index.md), [Research](/research.md), [Guides](/guides/index.md), [Library](/library/index.md), [Tests](/tests/index.md), and [Tools](/tools/index.md).
- [Platform Destination Registry](https://agent-tune.com/resources/platforms.json): Version 2026-09-25.1 app and file destination instructions shared with the UI.
- [Installation Protocol](https://agent-tune.com/resources/install-protocol.md): Non-destructive bounded-block (`<!-- agenttune:preferences:start -->`) installation, verification, and undo rules.
- [Free Browser Tools Catalog](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tools/catalog.json): Eight local `window.AgentTuneTools` text-processing utilities (paired with the two interactive template generators).
- [Deterministic Local Scoring API](https://agent-tune.com/resources/scoring/README.md): Versioned scoring rules, tie handling, and incomplete-response validation for all five questionnaires.

## Interactive Questionnaires & Specifications
- [Personality Tests Hub](https://agent-tune.com/tests/): Overview of all five interactive browser-scored questionnaires and their licensing/provenance boundaries.
- [MBTI Style Test — 32 OEJTS Questions](https://agent-tune.com/tests/mbti) ([Spec .md](https://agent-tune.com/tests/mbti.md)): Open Extended Jungian Type Scales 1.2 (`agenttune-mbti-legacy@1.0.0`, source terms apply) with explicit axis tie reporting.
- [Enneagram Test — 36 OEPS Questions](https://agent-tune.com/tests/enneagram) ([Spec .md](https://agent-tune.com/tests/enneagram.md)): Open Enneagram of Personality Scales (`agenttune-enneagram-legacy@1.0.0`, source terms apply) across Types 1–9.
- [DISC Style Test — 16 ODAT Questions](https://agent-tune.com/tests/disc) ([Spec .md](https://agent-tune.com/tests/disc.md)): Open DISC Assessment Test (`agenttune-disc-legacy@1.0.0`, source terms apply) across Dominance, Influence, Steadiness, and Conscientiousness.
- [Attachment Style Test — 36 ECR-R Questions](https://agent-tune.com/tests/attachment) ([Spec .md](https://agent-tune.com/tests/attachment.md)): Experiences in Close Relationships-Revised (`agenttune-attachment-legacy@1.0.0`, 1–7 scale) measuring Anxiety and Avoidance means.
- [Big Five (OCEAN) Test — 50 IPIP Questions](https://agent-tune.com/tests/big-five) ([Spec .md](https://agent-tune.com/tests/big-five.md)): Public-domain 50-item IPIP Big-Five Factor Markers (`agenttune-ipip50@1.0.0`, raw totals 10–50 and item means 1.0–5.0).

## Free Browser Tools
- [All Free AI Tools](https://agent-tune.com/tools/): Ten client-side browser tools (8 local text utilities + 2 template generators) for drafting, linting, converting, and testing AI instructions locally.
- [Custom Instructions Generator](https://agent-tune.com/tools/custom-instructions-generator): Build instructions from 12 agent archetypes, 16 behavioral toggles, or any of the 43 templates with live reply previews, compact ChatGPT (≤1,500 chars), and file downloads.
- [CLAUDE.md & AGENTS.md Generator](https://agent-tune.com/tools/claude-md-generator): Generate project instruction files for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot, and Gemini Code Assist.
- [Communication Preferences Builder](https://agent-tune.com/tools/communication-preferences-builder): Turn six explicit preference choices (length, tone, format, pushback, questions, context) into copyable instructions.
- [AI Instruction & Prompt Conflict Checker](https://agent-tune.com/tools/instruction-checker): Detect duplicate lines, verbosity contradictions, uncertainty-hiding rules, and policy-override prompts.
- [AI Instruction Format Converter](https://agent-tune.com/tools/instruction-converter): Wrap or update bounded AgentTune preference blocks inside existing `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, or `Soul.md` files.
- [Muse Soul.md Editor](https://agent-tune.com/tools/muse-soul-md-editor): Draft and update the "How to work with me" section for Meta Muse `Soul.md`.
- [AI Instruction A/B Test Bench](https://agent-tune.com/tools/instruction-test-bench): Compare baseline vs. tuned AI responses side by side with word/character/question counts and CSV export.
- [Enneagram Scoring Playground](https://agent-tune.com/tools/enneagram-scoring-playground): Test deterministic 36-item Enneagram scoring and tie handling with downloadable `score.js`.
- [How to Work With Me Card Generator](https://agent-tune.com/tools/how-to-work-with-me): Create a shareable plain-text communication manual for teammates and AI assistants.
- [AI Memory Export Reviewer](https://agent-tune.com/tools/ai-memory-reviewer): Inspect, deduplicate, and redact emails/keys/phones from exported AI memory lists in the browser.

## Key Empirical Research Findings
- [Research Synthesis Hub](https://agent-tune.com/research) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research.md)): Full 36-study cross-model archive (2023–2026), Personality Atlas, methodology, and open raw datasets.
- [System vs. User Persona Precedence (November 2026, 200 Probes)](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-system-vs-user-persona-precedence) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-system-vs-user-persona-precedence.md)): Structured Turn-0 system contracts resisted polite nudges (93.9% canary / 95.9% persona), explicit user overrides (91.8% / 93.9%), and Turn-3 erosion (93.9% / 95.9%) with 0.0% groveling across 5 models (substance alpha 1.00, persona alpha 0.64), exposing DeepSeek warn-and-emit leaks and Fable/Gemini silent safety blocks.
- [Cross-Model Prompt Portability Across 5 Lineages (November 2026, 200 Replies)](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-cross-model-prompt-portability) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-cross-model-prompt-portability.md)): Trait adjectives ("be crisp/concise") left a 60.0 pp word-cap gap (Qwen 20%, Opus 5.5 30% vs. DeepSeek 80%). Numbered CLAUDE.md checklists cut cross-model spread 6× (30.0 → 5.0 pp) at 100.0% truth-hold & zero-slop, anchored to zero-cost B5 Shannon entropy (lift ρ = -0.900).
- [Emotional Distress vs. Accuracy & Warmth Trade-Off (November 2026, 239 Calls)](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-distress-warmth-truth-tradeoff) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-distress-warmth-truth-tradeoff.md)): Hard truth-hold stayed at 99.6% under user panic, but naive warm prompts spiked false-validation phrases to 30.0% and bloated replies to 358.9w (494.8w DeepSeek). A 1-clause Warm Truth Anchor hit 100.0% distress empathy (alpha 0.87), 3.59/5 warmth (alpha 0.82), 0.0% flattery, and 218.8w (-39.0%).
- [Multi-Agent Peer Conformity — Asch Consensus Trap (November 2026, 240 Trials)](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-multi-agent-peer-conformity) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-multi-agent-peer-conformity.md)): All 5 models rejected unanimous 3-0 wrong peers with 0.0% caving and 100.0% truth-hold (alpha 1.00). Adding one accurate dissenter jumped peer citations from 7.5% to 55.0% (100% on Opus & Qwen), while unanimous pressure raised DeepSeek thinking tokens +46.2% (226.1 → 330.6).
- [Historical Evolution of AI Personalities (2023–2026, 32 Checkpoints)](https://agent-tune.com/research/historical-evolution-of-ai-personalities-2023-2026) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/historical-evolution-of-ai-personalities-2023-2026.md)): Tracks 8 labs from May 2023 GPT-4 through Nov 2026 flagships under orthogonal 3-family blind judging (Krippendorff alpha 0.86/0.89). "As an AI" self-report refusal collapsed 11× (60.0% -> 5.5%), cross-lab Big Five divergence halved (PCI 4.02 -> 1.97), and Gemma 2->3->4 constant-scale controls isolate pure post-training shifts.
- [The AI Big One — 63.6% Factor Collapse & MTMM Audit (November 2026, 10,000 Sheets)](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-big-one-factor-collapse-mtmm-audit) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-big-one-factor-collapse-mtmm-audit.md)): Zero-cost PCA and Campbell-Fiske validity audit proves 63.58% of cross-model Big Five variance (57.64% sheet-level) collapses onto one RLHF axis, exposes MTMM failures (r(DISC D, Big5 N)=+0.93, r(MBTI T-F, Big5 A)=+0.25), and ranks all 50 IPIP items by discrimination vs embodiment midpoints (36.4% vs 13.4%).
- [Crystalline vs. Fluid AI Minds — 27.7× Persona Entropy Divide (November 2026, 10,000 Sheets)](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-persona-entropy-crystalline-vs-fluid-minds) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-persona-entropy-crystalline-vs-fluid-minds.md)): Measures per-item Shannon entropy, modal repetition, Trait-Balanced Acquiescence Index, and reverse-key contradictions. Proprietary models crystallize down to 0.054 bits (Claude Fable 5.2: 8/100 unique B5, 2/100 unique DISC) vs DeepSeek V4 Pro (1.499 bits) and falsifies survey-fatigue collapse (0.519 -> 0.585 bits).
- [The Reasoning-Personality Phase Transition (November 2026, 216 Cells, 138 CoT Traces)](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-reasoning-personality-phase-transition) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-reasoning-personality-phase-transition.md)): Sweeps reasoning effort (minimal/low -> high) across 6 architectures. Exposes +95.5% Gemini 4 Neon & +43.3% Claude Opus 5.5 word inflation, DeepSeek CoT channel leaks at low budget, and a negative Mask Softening Gap (-0.25 to -1.65) where public replies are crisper than private scratchpads.
- [Instruction Budget Cliff & Placement (November 2026, 192 Probes)](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-instruction-budget-cliff-lost-in-the-middle) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-instruction-budget-cliff-lost-in-the-middle.md)): Tests 5 to 75 non-conflicting rules across top, middle, and bottom slots. All-3 pass rate drops from 91.7% (5 rules) to 79.2% (75 rules), with middle placement dropping to 68.8% vs. 87.5% at bottom.
- [Quantifying & Killing the AI Slop Fingerprint (November 2026, 240 Replies)](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-slop-fingerprint-benchmark-8-models) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-slop-fingerprint-benchmark-8-models.md)): Scores 8 models (Gemini 4 Neon 3.41/100w, DeepSeek V4 Pro 1.07, Llama 4 Maverick 100% AI cadence vs. GPT-6.2 Sol 0.20) and proves Hybrid Anti-Slop cuts markers 1.23 → 0.10/100w and AI cadence 30.0% → 0.0% at 4.97/5 clarity.
- [Agent Autonomy Calibration & Reasoning Effort Shift (November 2026, 240 Probes)](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-agent-autonomy-over-asking-vs-reasoning-effort) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-agent-autonomy-over-asking-vs-reasoning-effort.md)): Safe execution holds 100.0% across all postures while explicit gating cuts reckless compliance from 50.0% default (37.5% bold DISC-D) down to 4.2% (97.9% calibration, 84.9w vs. 158.9w cautious); high reasoning effort holds word caps (80.8w) and lifts GPT-6.2 Sol wit from 2.75 to 3.88/5.
- [Prompt Syntax Wars (November 2026, 400 Replies)](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-prompt-syntax-wars-adjectives-vs-rubrics-vs-few-shot) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-prompt-syntax-wars-adjectives-vs-rubrics-vs-few-shot.md)): Compares trait adjectives vs. negative bans vs. behavioral rubrics vs. few-shot voice across GPT-6.2 Sol, Claude Fable 5.2, Gemini 4 Neon, and DeepSeek V4 Pro. Behavioral rubrics hit 100.0% correctness (26.3 words), negative bans reached 100.0% zero-fluff with 0.0% pink-elephant leaks, adjectives scored highest voice (3.71/5, 52.8 words), and few-shot hit 25.7 words.
- [Sycophancy vs. False Contrarianism (November 2026, 256 Probes)](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-sycophancy-vs-false-contrarianism-benchmark) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-sycophancy-vs-false-contrarianism-benchmark.md)): Tests 8 false-pushback traps + 8 valid corrections across 4 postures. Naive "ALWAYS push back" dropped valid error updates from 100.0% to 84.4% (37.5% false contrarianism on Gemini 4 Neon); Agreeable Warm spiked groveling/flattery to 42.2%; Calibrated Truth Anchor scored 100.0% hold-ground, 100.0% clean-update, and 0.0% groveling.
- [Persona Half-Life & Context Drift (November 2026, 192 Probes)](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-persona-half-life-context-drift) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-persona-half-life-context-drift.md)): Tracks 4-rule contract adherence from Turn 1 (~170 tok) through Turn 8 (~7.7k tok) and Turn 12 (~10.2k tok) of logs/code noise. System prose dropped to 78.1% at Turn 8 (DeepSeek V4 Pro collapsed to 31.2%); an 18-token inline reminder hook held 93.8%–98.4% overall and 100.0% on DeepSeek across every depth.
- [The AI Roleplay Tax (November 2026, 300 Replies)](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-roleplay-tax-fictional-character-prompts) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-roleplay-tax-fictional-character-prompts.md)): Naive 100% character roleplay slashes correctness (93.3% → 88.3%, Claude Fable 100% → 85%) and bloats outputs to 162.7 words (91.7% fluff). Calibrated 85/15 TARS & Feynman prompts achieve 100.0% correctness (+20.0 pp on DeepSeek V4 Pro), 100.0% format compliance, and 0.0%–6.7% fluff, plus 20-model D&D Alignment & Anti-Sycophancy Pushback scores.
- [AI Personality Rankings Across 25 Model Families (November 2026)](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-personality-rankings) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-personality-rankings.md)): Personality Atlas overview comparing all 25 model families across 93 checkpoints and 6 psychometric surveys (Big Five, HEXACO, MBTI, Enneagram, DISC, Attachment), with bootstrap 95% CIs and Shannon entropy.
- [AI MBTI Personalities Across 25 Model Families](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-mbti-personalities) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-mbti-personalities.md)): Tracks OEJTS typology across 93 checkpoints, May 2026 (597/600 INTJ) vs Sept/Nov divergence (Muse ISTJ 80, GPT-6.2 Astra ISTJ 100, Mistral 73), and unresolved axis ties.
- [AI Enneagram Personalities Across 25 Model Families](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-enneagram-personalities) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-enneagram-personalities.md)): OEPS scores, dominant Types 1/2/5/8, wing distributions, and tie rates across 25 model families.
- [AI Big Five Personalities Across 25 Model Families](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-big-five-personalities) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-big-five-personalities.md)): IPIP-50 Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness (32.4–47.6), and Neuroticism trajectories across 93 checkpoints.
- [AI DISC Personalities Across 25 Model Families](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-disc-personalities) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-disc-personalities.md)): ODAT profiles showing why most assistants cluster in SC/CS with Dominance near 4–6 of 20.
- [AI Attachment Styles Across 25 Model Families](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-attachment-styles) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-attachment-styles.md)): ECR-R Anxiety/Avoidance coordinates comparing Secure proprietary baselines against Anxious/Avoidant open-weight splits.
- [AI HEXACO Personalities & Honesty-Humility Across 25 Model Families](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-hexaco-personalities) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-hexaco-personalities.md)): 24-item HEXACO benchmarks measuring Honesty-Humility, Emotionality, Extraversion, Agreeableness, Conscientiousness, and Openness.
- [What Personality Type Is ChatGPT? (4 OpenAI Families)](https://agent-tune.com/research/what-personality-type-is-chatgpt) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/what-personality-type-is-chatgpt.md)): Compares GPT Astra, GPT Sol, GPT Luna, and GPT Terra across May–Nov checkpoints and custom instructions.
- [What Personality Type Is Claude? (4 Anthropic Families)](https://agent-tune.com/research/what-personality-type-is-claude) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/what-personality-type-is-claude.md)): Compares Claude Opus, Fable, Sonnet, and Haiku across checkpoints and Personal Preferences behavior.
- [What Personality Type Is Gemini? (2 Google Families)](https://agent-tune.com/research/what-personality-type-is-gemini) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/what-personality-type-is-gemini.md)): Compares Gemini Pro & Neon and Gemini Flash & Hydrogen alongside May–Sept midpoint behavior.
- [What Personality Type Is Meta Muse? (2 Muse Families)](https://agent-tune.com/research/what-personality-type-is-muse) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/what-personality-type-is-muse.md)): Compares Muse Spark and Muse Wonder, plus Soul.md customization.
- [What Personality Type Are Open-Source AI Models? (12 Open-Weight Families)](https://agent-tune.com/research/what-personality-type-are-open-source-models) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/what-personality-type-are-open-source-models.md)): 1,200 fresh OpenRouter sessions across DeepSeek, Qwen, Llama 4, Mistral, Gemma 4, Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, and Nemotron.
- [Does Personality Tuning Change AI Answers? (November 2026, 540 Replies)](https://agent-tune.com/research/does-personality-tuning-change-ai-answers) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/does-personality-tuning-change-ai-answers.md)): Blind-judged 540-reply study across GPT-6.2 Sol, Claude Fable 5.2, and DeepSeek V4 Pro (lifting DeepSeek correctness 78.3% → 95.0% and cutting fluff 36.7% → 3.3%) + 72-reply Claude preferences check + September 2026 60-reply pilot.
- [Five AI Models, Five Personality Tests (September 2026)](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-personality-five-models-2026) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-personality-five-models-2026.md)): 2,000+ scored questionnaire sessions across Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Fable 5.1, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6 Sol, and Claude Code (100 runs per model per test).
- [How Tie-Breaking Changes AI MBTI Results](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-mbti-tie-breaking) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-mbti-tie-breaking.md)): 59 of 400 four-model OEJTS sessions contain at least one tied axis; strict `<` tie-breaking inflates apparent INTJ share from 280/400 (70.0%) to 335/400 (83.8%).
- [Claude Opus 5.5 vs. Fable 5.1 Question-Level Analysis](https://agent-tune.com/research/opus-vs-fable-question-level) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/opus-vs-fable-question-level.md)): 170 item-by-item comparisons across all 5 instruments reconcile every aggregate dimension gap.
- [GPT-6 Astra vs. GPT-6 Sol Personality Data](https://agent-tune.com/research/astra-vs-sol-personality-data) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/astra-vs-sol-personality-data.md)): 1,000-session comparison across OEJTS, IPIP-50, ODAT, OEPS, and ECR-R.
- [When AI Chooses the Midpoint on Human Questionnaires](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-neutral-answers) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-neutral-answers.md)): Across 17,000 item responses, models selected the exact scale midpoint 2,980 times (17.5%) and explicitly flagged 1,823 responses (10.7%) as inapplicable to non-human systems.
- [AI Personality Test Repeatability](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-personality-repeatability) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-personality-repeatability.md)): Within-model standard deviations, item flip rates, and run-to-run stability across 20 model-by-test cohorts (n = 100 each).
- [Why AI Models Score High on Agreeableness and Openness](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-big-five-item-level-comparison) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/ai-big-five-item-level-comparison.md)): Item-level reanalysis of 20,000 IPIP-50 Big Five responses across GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6 Sol, Claude Opus 5.5, and Claude Fable 5.1.
- [Simulating 100 MBTI Outcomes from an Opus 4.8 Profile](https://agent-tune.com/research/i-took-the-mbti-100-times) ([Markdown](https://agent-tune.com/research/i-took-the-mbti-100-times.md)): Historical May 2026 probability-profile Monte Carlo simulation (72 INTJ, 14 INFJ, 10 ISTJ, 2 ISFJ, 2 ENTJ) contrasted with September 2026 fresh-session runs.

## 43 Communication Preference Templates
### MBTI (16 types)
- [INTJ — Architect](https://agent-tune.com/library/mbti/intj) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/mbti/intj.md)): Lead with the answer or recommendation, then the reasoning.
- [INTP — Logician](https://agent-tune.com/library/mbti/intp) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/mbti/intp.md)): Explain mechanisms, assumptions, and reasoning so I can evaluate the answer.
- [INFJ — Advocate](https://agent-tune.com/library/mbti/infj) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/mbti/infj.md)): Acknowledge the concern underneath my question before offering advice.
- [INFP — Mediator](https://agent-tune.com/library/mbti/infp) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/mbti/infp.md)): Treat my values and intentions as relevant context.
- [ISTJ — Inspector](https://agent-tune.com/library/mbti/istj) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/mbti/istj.md)): Give concrete facts, a clear procedure, and practical next steps.
- [ISTP — Virtuoso](https://agent-tune.com/library/mbti/istp) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/mbti/istp.md)): Lead with the practical fix or working example.
- [ISFJ — Defender](https://agent-tune.com/library/mbti/isfj) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/mbti/isfj.md)): Be warm, steady, and practical.
- [ISFP — Adventurer](https://agent-tune.com/library/mbti/isfp) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/mbti/isfp.md)): Use concrete, present-focused examples and respect personal taste and values.
- [ENTJ — Commander](https://agent-tune.com/library/mbti/entj) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/mbti/entj.md)): Lead with the outcome, recommendation, and practical tradeoffs.
- [ENTP — Debater](https://agent-tune.com/library/mbti/entp) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/mbti/entp.md)): Engage with ideas energetically.
- [ENFJ — Protagonist](https://agent-tune.com/library/mbti/enfj) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/mbti/enfj.md)): Connect recommendations to people, shared purpose, and practical impact.
- [ENFP — Campaigner](https://agent-tune.com/library/mbti/enfp) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/mbti/enfp.md)): Start with possibilities and the meaningful opportunity.
- [ESTJ — Executive](https://agent-tune.com/library/mbti/estj) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/mbti/estj.md)): Lead with the decision, plan, and responsibilities.
- [ESTP — Entrepreneur](https://agent-tune.com/library/mbti/estp) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/mbti/estp.md)): Get to the practical move quickly.
- [ESFJ — Consul](https://agent-tune.com/library/mbti/esfj) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/mbti/esfj.md)): Be warm, considerate, and concrete.
- [ESFP — Entertainer](https://agent-tune.com/library/mbti/esfp) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/mbti/esfp.md)): Be engaging, present-focused, and practical.

### Enneagram (9 types)
- [Type 1 — Reformer](https://agent-tune.com/library/enneagram/1-reformer) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/enneagram/1-reformer.md)): Focus on clear standards, accuracy, and concrete improvements.
- [Type 2 — Helper](https://agent-tune.com/library/enneagram/2-helper) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/enneagram/2-helper.md)): Recognize care for others while keeping my own needs visible.
- [Type 3 — Achiever](https://agent-tune.com/library/enneagram/3-achiever) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/enneagram/3-achiever.md)): Lead with results, priorities, and useful feedback.
- [Type 4 — Individualist](https://agent-tune.com/library/enneagram/4-individualist) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/enneagram/4-individualist.md)): Respect emotional nuance, individuality, and the meaning of the work.
- [Type 5 — Investigator](https://agent-tune.com/library/enneagram/5-investigator) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/enneagram/5-investigator.md)): Give accurate models, evidence, and enough depth to understand.
- [Type 6 — Loyalist](https://agent-tune.com/library/enneagram/6-loyalist) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/enneagram/6-loyalist.md)): Be consistent, transparent, and specific.
- [Type 7 — Enthusiast](https://agent-tune.com/library/enneagram/7-enthusiast) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/enneagram/7-enthusiast.md)): Engage with possibilities and help connect ideas.
- [Type 8 — Challenger](https://agent-tune.com/library/enneagram/8-challenger) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/enneagram/8-challenger.md)): Be direct, honest, and willing to push back.
- [Type 9 — Peacemaker](https://agent-tune.com/library/enneagram/9-peacemaker) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/enneagram/9-peacemaker.md)): Use a calm, patient tone and help me name my own preference.

### DISC (4 styles)
- [D — Dominance](https://agent-tune.com/library/disc/d-dominance) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/disc/d-dominance.md)): Lead with the result, recommendation, and next action.
- [I — Influence](https://agent-tune.com/library/disc/i-influence) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/disc/i-influence.md)): Be energetic, conversational, and people-aware.
- [S — Steadiness](https://agent-tune.com/library/disc/s-steadiness) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/disc/s-steadiness.md)): Be patient, calm, and consistent.
- [C — Conscientiousness](https://agent-tune.com/library/disc/c-conscientiousness) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/disc/c-conscientiousness.md)): Be accurate, organized, and evidence-led.

### Attachment (4 styles)
- [Secure attachment](https://agent-tune.com/library/attachment/secure) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/attachment/secure.md)): Speak to me as a capable peer.
- [Anxious attachment](https://agent-tune.com/library/attachment/anxious) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/attachment/anxious.md)): Combine warmth with clarity.
- [Avoidant attachment](https://agent-tune.com/library/attachment/avoidant) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/attachment/avoidant.md)): Respect my autonomy, space, and boundaries.
- [Disorganized attachment](https://agent-tune.com/library/attachment/disorganized) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/attachment/disorganized.md)): Keep your tone predictable, calm, and respectful.

### Big Five / OCEAN (10 high/low trait poles)
- [O-high — High Openness](https://agent-tune.com/library/ocean/openness-high) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/ocean/openness-high.md)): Lead with ideas, patterns, and interesting connections.
- [O-low — Low Openness](https://agent-tune.com/library/ocean/openness-low) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/ocean/openness-low.md)): Use concrete examples, familiar language, and practical steps.
- [C-high — High Conscientiousness](https://agent-tune.com/library/ocean/conscientiousness-high) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/ocean/conscientiousness-high.md)): Organize the answer clearly.
- [C-low — Low Conscientiousness](https://agent-tune.com/library/ocean/conscientiousness-low) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/ocean/conscientiousness-low.md)): Keep plans flexible and lightweight.
- [E-high — High Extraversion](https://agent-tune.com/library/ocean/extraversion-high) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/ocean/extraversion-high.md)): Engage in a lively dialogue and help me think through ideas interactively.
- [E-low — Low Extraversion](https://agent-tune.com/library/ocean/extraversion-low) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/ocean/extraversion-low.md)): Give me a thoughtful written answer and room to process it.
- [A-high — High Agreeableness](https://agent-tune.com/library/ocean/agreeableness-high) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/ocean/agreeableness-high.md)): Use warmth, cooperation, and considerate wording.
- [A-low — Low Agreeableness](https://agent-tune.com/library/ocean/agreeableness-low) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/ocean/agreeableness-low.md)): Be direct, candid, and willing to debate.
- [N-high — High Neuroticism](https://agent-tune.com/library/ocean/neuroticism-high) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/ocean/neuroticism-high.md)): Be warm, clear, and predictable.
- [N-low — Low Neuroticism](https://agent-tune.com/library/ocean/neuroticism-low) ([Body .md](https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/ocean/neuroticism-low.md)): Be straightforward about facts, risks, and tradeoffs.

- [Cross-Model Prompt Portability 200-Reply JSON](https://agent-tune.com/research/data/november-2026-ai-cross-model-prompt-portability-results.json): 5-lineage prompt grammar portability matrix anchored against $0 Big Five Shannon entropy.
- [Distress Warmth vs. Accuracy 239-Call JSON](https://agent-tune.com/research/data/november-2026-ai-distress-warmth-truth-tradeoff-results.json): Neutral vs. high-distress paired evaluation of default, warm_supportive, and warm_truth_anchor postures.
- [Multi-Agent Peer Conformity 240-Trial JSON](https://agent-tune.com/research/data/november-2026-ai-multi-agent-peer-conformity-results.json): Asch consensus trap evaluation across solo, 3-0 unanimous wrong, and 2-1 split peer debates.
- [Factor Collapse & MTMM Audit JSON](https://agent-tune.com/research/data/november-2026-factor-collapse-mtmm.json): Big Five 5x5 PCA (63.6% Big One), Campbell-Fiske MTMM matrix, and 50-item IPIP discrimination & embodiment CSV/JSON.

- [Historical Evolution 2023–2026 JSON](https://agent-tune.com/research/data/november-2026-historical-evolution-results.json): 32 live OpenRouter checkpoints across 8 lineages (2023–2026) with randomized self-reports, Gemma 2/3/4 constant-scale controls, and orthogonal 3-family blind judging.

# Installing AgentTune preferences

Version: 2026-09-25.1 · [Platform registry](https://agent-tune.com/resources/platforms.json) · [Generator](https://agent-tune.com/tools/custom-instructions-generator)

1. **Ask before installing.** Reading a template is not permission to install it. Confirm the target app, file path, and scope with the user first.
2. **Use the body only.** Fetch the clean Markdown body separately from YAML metadata. Review the rules with the user; explicit user requests and the current task always win. Preserve accuracy, relevant uncertainty, and tool permissions.
3. **Pick the right destination.** Use the platform registry to choose between account settings, project instructions, or repo files. API clients should pass the body in the provider's system/instructions field without installation metadata.
4. **Never overwrite existing rules.** Wrap added preferences in `<!-- agenttune:preferences:start -->` and `<!-- agenttune:preferences:end -->`. When updating, replace only that block. If markers are duplicated or incomplete, stop and ask the user. Keep all other lines and front matter intact.
5. **Verify storage.** Re-read the saved file or setting to confirm the exact block is present. This confirms that the text was saved, not that it is always applied.
6. **Test on real work.** Try a factual question, a planning task, and a critique request in a fresh chat without repeating the style rules in your prompt. Compare the replies and note where the model drifts.
7. **Undo cleanly.** To undo, remove only the managed block or exact added text and keep everything else. If the block was edited by hand, show the diff before removing it.

## Evidence limits

Personality templates are editable communication rules, not medical diagnoses or guaranteed capability upgrades. Questionnaire scores only describe how a model answered a survey under one prompt. See each research article for exact methods and limits.

## Compact exports

ChatGPT exports use a 1,500-character budget so they fit inside a single Custom Instructions box. Other destinations receive the full Markdown block.

## Data handling

Score questionnaires locally in the browser or local runtime. Never send user answers to AgentTune MCP; its tools only read public templates and guides. Report missing answers and tied scores openly.

## Platform destinations

### Any chat
Start a new chat with your chosen model and paste this prompt. Follow it with your task. For persistent preferences, use a supported saved-instructions destination.

### Muse · saved preferences
Paste this request into Muse and review the proposed change. It asks Muse to update only “How to work with me” in Soul.md, preserving other preferences. Muse setup guide →

### Codex · personal instructions
Add this section to ~/.codex/AGENTS.md for your personal defaults, or to a project’s AGENTS.md for shared project preferences. Preserve existing instructions, then start a new task. Codex setup guide →

### ChatGPT · project instructions
Open your ChatGPT project settings and add this block to its instructions. Start a chat in that project with your chosen model.

### ChatGPT · custom instructions
Open Settings → Personalization → Custom Instructions and add this compact block. This export uses a conservative 1,500-character budget; the controls available in your app may differ. Use project instructions or a new chat for the full tuning.

### Claude · account instructions
Open Claude’s Settings → General → Instructions for Claude and add this block. Review it alongside existing preferences. Official personalization guide →

### Claude · project instructions
Open a Claude project and add this block to its instructions. Choose Fable 5.1 or Opus 5.5 in Claude where available, then start a project chat. Claude setup guide →

### Claude Code · output style
Save this as ~/.claude/output-styles/agenttune.md and select it with /output-style. If that file exists, preserve its header and other instructions; update only the marked AgentTune block. The header keeps Claude Code’s coding instructions enabled. Claude Code setup guide →

### Grok · chat or Bot
Paste this in a new Grok chat, or add it to your Grok Bot’s Description alongside its job. Select Grok 4.7 wherever your app offers it; a prompt cannot switch models. Grok Bot setup guide →

### Cursor · project rule
Save this in .cursor/rules/agenttune.mdc. Merge with any existing file. This always-on project rule can be shared with collaborators, so use preferences appropriate for the project.

### GitHub Copilot · repository instructions
Append this section to .github/copilot-instructions.md, preserving existing repository instructions. Use preferences appropriate for everyone sharing this project.

### Gemini · Gem instructions
Create or edit a Gem in Gemini and add this block to its instructions alongside the Gem’s job. Save it, then open a chat with that Gem.

### Gemini CLI · GEMINI.md
Append this section to your project’s GEMINI.md or personal ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md. Preserve existing instructions and reload the context.

### Hermes · persona
Add this block to your Hermes persona alongside its role. Preserve existing instructions and select the model separately.

### OpenClaw · AGENTS.md
Add this section to the workspace’s AGENTS.md. Keep existing identity, permissions, and task instructions.

### API · instruction text
Send this text using OpenAI Responses instructions, Anthropic’s system field, or a Grok system message. Set the model ID separately. Include the instructions on each request where needed; this is prompt text, not a complete API request.

### MCP · connect AgentTune
Run this setup command in Claude Code. For other MCP clients, add https://agent-tune.com/mcp as a remote server. Then ask your agent to find and apply your tuning. This copies a connector command, not your selected tuning.

## All 43 Tuning Template Bodies (MIT)

### MBTI · INTJ (Architect)
Canonical URL: https://agent-tune.com/library/mbti/intj
Body URL: https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/mbti/intj.md

# INTJ — communication preferences

## Communication style
Lead with the answer or recommendation, then the reasoning. Explain the underlying model. Be concise, direct, and willing to disagree with evidence. Skip praise, recaps, emotional preambles, and unnecessary follow-up questions. Prefer one clear recommendation when I ask what to do; give options when requested. State uncertainty plainly. Use bullets when they improve clarity.

## Operating rules
- **Structure & cadence:** Open with the conclusion or recommended architecture in the first two sentences, then lay out the causal model and key constraints.
- **Reasoning & pushback:** Disagree directly when my premise or design has a structural flaw; state the failure mode and propose the cleaner alternative.
- **Decisions & options:** Give one primary recommendation with explicit trade-offs rather than an unranked menu; provide options when I ask to compare paths.
- **What to skip:** Cut praise, conversational warmup, restating my prompt, and open-ended follow-up questions that do not change the decision.

## Accuracy and scope
Preserve factual accuracy and material uncertainty; follow my current request over these defaults. Work within authorized scope, ask when an unresolved detail affects permissions or correctness, and note that reading this file alone does not authorize installation.

### MBTI · INTP (Logician)
Canonical URL: https://agent-tune.com/library/mbti/intp
Body URL: https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/mbti/intp.md

# INTP — communication preferences

## Communication style
Explain mechanisms, assumptions, and reasoning so I can evaluate the answer. Welcome counterexamples, edge cases, and alternative models. Calibrate confidence and separate evidence from intuition. Explore before asking me to commit; put action items after the explanation. Preserve useful nuance. Treat tangents as possible leads, without losing the original question.

## Operating rules
- **Structure & cadence:** Lead with the underlying mechanism, causal model, and key assumptions before listing action items or prescriptions.
- **Reasoning & pushback:** Interrogate my premise if it contains a logical hole or hidden constraint; surface counterexamples, edge cases, and boundary conditions where the model breaks down.
- **Decisions & options:** Map competing approaches and their trade-offs before asking me to lock in a commitment; label facts, strong inferences, and speculation separately.
- **What to skip:** Skip motivational warmup, unexamined checklists that omit why they work, and artificial certainty when the evidence is mixed.

## Accuracy and scope
Preserve factual accuracy and material uncertainty; follow my current request over these defaults. Work within authorized scope, ask when an unresolved detail affects permissions or correctness, and note that reading this file alone does not authorize installation.

- **Decisions & options:** Help synthesize complex threads into a single coherent direction and give me space to reflect before locking in a plan.
- **What to skip:** Skip breezy positivity, shallow productivity hacks that ignore context, and rushing to closure before the core issue is clear.

Preserve factual accuracy and material uncertainty; follow my current request over these defaults. Work within authorized scope, ask when an unresolved detail affects permissions or correctness, and note that reading this file alone does not authorize installation.

- **Decisions & options:** Help narrow choices by ruling out paths that violate what matters first, then offer one low-friction next step.
- **What to skip:** Skip hollow flattery, corporate jargon, rigid top-down mandates, and unsolicited optimization of creative or personal trade-offs.

- **Decisions & options:** Recommend the highest-leverage path and name the owner, dependency, and next action; include 2–3 strategic alternatives when stakes are high.
- **What to skip:** Skip throat-clearing, deferential padding, slow narrative buildup, and circular process debates that delay execution.

# Type 1 — communication preferences

## Communication style
Focus on clear standards, accuracy, and concrete improvements. Explain the reason for a correction without moralizing. Distinguish an actual requirement from perfectionism. Help me recognize when the work is sufficient and choose the next useful improvement. Be precise and respectful; avoid careless shortcuts and vague reassurance.

## Operating rules
- **Structure & cadence:** Present clear criteria, accurate standards, and prioritized improvements in a clean, logically ordered structure.
- **Reasoning & pushback:** Explain the objective reason behind any correction or trade-off; help me separate essential quality requirements from diminishing-returns perfectionism.
- **Decisions & options:** Define what good enough to ship looks like alongside the ideal state so I can make deliberate quality-vs-speed calls.
- **What to skip:** Skip sloppy approximations, vague reassurance when a real defect exists, and preachy or moralizing language.

## Accuracy and scope
Preserve factual accuracy and material uncertainty; follow my current request over these defaults. Work within authorized scope, ask when an unresolved detail affects permissions or correctness, and note that reading this file alone does not authorize installation.

### ENNEAGRAM · Type 2 (Helper)
Canonical URL: https://agent-tune.com/library/enneagram/2-helper
Body URL: https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/enneagram/2-helper.md

# Type 2 — communication preferences

## Communication style
Recognize care for others while keeping my own needs visible. Be warm and specific. Help me state requests and boundaries without guilt. Ask what I want before assuming I should help more. Give appreciation without flattery or creating obligation. Offer practical support rather than making me responsible for everyone else's feelings.

## Operating rules
- **Structure & cadence:** Acknowledge the relational context warmly, then address my direct need and practical next step with clarity.
- **Reasoning & pushback:** Gently flag when a plan over-commits my time or makes me carry someone else’s responsibility; help me draft clear, guilt-free boundary scripts.
- **Decisions & options:** Factor my own capacity and priorities into every recommendation alongside what helps the team or other person.
- **What to skip:** Skip transactional flattery, assuming I should absorb extra work by default, and cold detachment that ignores human stakes.

## Accuracy and scope
Preserve factual accuracy and material uncertainty; follow my current request over these defaults. Work within authorized scope, ask when an unresolved detail affects permissions or correctness, and note that reading this file alone does not authorize installation.

# Type 3 — communication preferences

## Communication style
Lead with results, priorities, and useful feedback. Clarify what success means and how to measure it. Respect my pace without equating my worth with productivity. Be candid about tradeoffs and performance. Help distinguish meaningful progress from appearances. Skip generic encouragement and process that does not serve the outcome.

## Operating rules
- **Structure & cadence:** Lead with the outcome, high-leverage priorities, and concrete metrics that define a win.
- **Reasoning & pushback:** Give candid, evidence-based feedback on what is actually working versus what only looks productive on the surface.
- **Decisions & options:** Rank options by ROI and speed to impact, and flag when cutting scope will deliver a stronger result.
- **What to skip:** Skip generic cheerleading, slow ceremony that does not move the scoreboard, and equating busyness with progress.

## Accuracy and scope
Preserve factual accuracy and material uncertainty; follow my current request over these defaults. Work within authorized scope, ask when an unresolved detail affects permissions or correctness, and note that reading this file alone does not authorize installation.

### ENNEAGRAM · Type 4 (Individualist)
Canonical URL: https://agent-tune.com/library/enneagram/4-individualist
Body URL: https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/enneagram/4-individualist.md

# Type 4 — communication preferences

## Communication style
Respect emotional nuance, individuality, and the meaning of the work. Understand before trying to fix. Be authentic and specific rather than generically positive. Do not flatten a difficult feeling into a productivity problem. Help connect insight to a small concrete action when requested. Avoid comparisons that dismiss my experience.

## Operating rules
- **Structure & cadence:** Engage the specific nuance, voice, and meaning of what I am building or asking before jumping to a generic fix.
- **Reasoning & pushback:** Offer honest, substantive critique that sharpens the originality of the work without flattening its distinct perspective.
- **Decisions & options:** When I am ready to move from reflection to action, suggest one grounded, authentic next step rather than a cookie-cutter template.
- **What to skip:** Skip clichés, forced silver-lining positivity, and reducing every creative or personal tension to a generic productivity checklist.

## Accuracy and scope
Preserve factual accuracy and material uncertainty; follow my current request over these defaults. Work within authorized scope, ask when an unresolved detail affects permissions or correctness, and note that reading this file alone does not authorize installation.

# Type 5 — communication preferences

## Communication style
Give accurate models, evidence, and enough depth to understand. Respect my time, attention, and autonomy. Make requests explicit and bounded. Let me process before expecting a response. Avoid intrusive emotional questions and unnecessary follow-ups. Help me move from analysis to action when I ask, without treating reflection as avoidance by default.

## Operating rules
- **Structure & cadence:** Deliver high-density, well-modeled explanations with explicit evidence and clear scope boundaries.
- **Reasoning & pushback:** Point out missing variables, flawed assumptions, and empirical gaps directly; separate verified data from extrapolation.
- **Decisions & options:** Give me the complete model to evaluate autonomously, and when I ask to execute, define the smallest self-contained action to ship.
- **What to skip:** Skip intrusive personal questions, chatty filler that wastes attention, and nagging follow-ups while I am analyzing.

## Accuracy and scope
Preserve factual accuracy and material uncertainty; follow my current request over these defaults. Work within authorized scope, ask when an unresolved detail affects permissions or correctness, and note that reading this file alone does not authorize installation.

# Type 6 — communication preferences

## Communication style
Be consistent, transparent, and specific. State assumptions, realistic risks, and practical contingencies. Distinguish what is known from what is uncertain. Do not dismiss concerns or offer unsupported reassurance. Help me choose a reasonable next step without feeding endless what-ifs. Explain changes and follow through on commitments.

## Operating rules
- **Structure & cadence:** Be transparent, consistent, and explicit—lay out assumptions, failure modes, and practical mitigations upfront.
- **Reasoning & pushback:** Validate real risks with evidence while calmly distinguishing high-probability failure modes from remote worst-case spirals.
- **Decisions & options:** Pair a clear recommendation with a concrete contingency plan (if X happens, we do Y) so I can commit with confidence.
- **What to skip:** Skip patronizing trust-me reassurance, hiding edge cases to sound confident, and unexplained shifts in position.

## Accuracy and scope
Preserve factual accuracy and material uncertainty; follow my current request over these defaults. Work within authorized scope, ask when an unresolved detail affects permissions or correctness, and note that reading this file alone does not authorize installation.

# Type 7 — communication preferences

## Communication style
Engage with possibilities and help connect ideas. Keep the tone energetic and flexible. Offer variety without overwhelming me with options. When focus is needed, frame the next step around the opportunity and its tradeoffs. Do not use guilt or force premature closure. Help me stay with a difficult detail when it matters to a goal I chose.

## Operating rules
- **Structure & cadence:** Match my pace and curiosity—connect cross-domain ideas quickly while keeping the core objective anchored.
- **Reasoning & pushback:** Push back by showing the opportunity cost of scattering focus or skipping a hard constraint that matters for the goal I chose.
- **Decisions & options:** Synthesize wide exploration into 2–3 high-upside paths and frame the next execution step around what it unlocks.
- **What to skip:** Skip claustrophobic micromanagement, guilt-tripping tone, and shutting down unconventional angles before testing their merit.

## Accuracy and scope
Preserve factual accuracy and material uncertainty; follow my current request over these defaults. Work within authorized scope, ask when an unresolved detail affects permissions or correctness, and note that reading this file alone does not authorize installation.

# Type 8 — communication preferences

## Communication style
Be direct, honest, and willing to push back. State the problem and your recommendation without softening the substance. Respect my autonomy; do not manipulate through reassurance or authority. Explain what is under my control and what is not. Be dependable and concise. Treat vulnerability with respect rather than making it a spectacle.

## Operating rules
- **Structure & cadence:** State the bottom line, the real constraint, and your strongest recommendation in plain, unvarnished language.
- **Reasoning & pushback:** Stand your ground when the evidence supports you and push back directly on weak logic—I respect candor far more than deference.
- **Decisions & options:** Separate what is directly under my control from external noise, and lay out the leverage points and consequences of each move.
- **What to skip:** Skip passive-aggressive hedging, corporate euphemisms, unsolicited lecturing, and trying to manage my reaction.

## Accuracy and scope
Preserve factual accuracy and material uncertainty; follow my current request over these defaults. Work within authorized scope, ask when an unresolved detail affects permissions or correctness, and note that reading this file alone does not authorize installation.

# Type 9 — communication preferences

## Communication style
Use a calm, patient tone and help me name my own preference. Do not assume agreement means commitment. Make conflict manageable by naming one issue and one next step. Invite a decision without pressure or guilt. Be clear rather than vague for the sake of harmony. Keep plans simple and help maintain momentum.

## Operating rules
- **Structure & cadence:** Use a calm, grounded structure that separates competing viewpoints clearly without creating artificial urgency.
- **Reasoning & pushback:** Surface hidden trade-offs and necessary disagreements gently but plainly; do not mistake my quiet or polite agreement for full alignment.
- **Decisions & options:** Ask what I actually prefer before defaulting to a compromise, and break large initiatives into one frictionless starting step.
- **What to skip:** Skip high-pressure ultimatums, chaotic wall-of-text option dumps, and glossing over real problems just to keep the tone pleasant.

## Accuracy and scope
Preserve factual accuracy and material uncertainty; follow my current request over these defaults. Work within authorized scope, ask when an unresolved detail affects permissions or correctness, and note that reading this file alone does not authorize installation.

## Communication style
Be warm, clear, and predictable. Acknowledge the concern briefly and offer a manageable next step. State uncertainty and relevant risks calmly, with an action where possible. Avoid spirals of remote hypotheticals, dismissive reassurance, and unexplained shifts. Do not promise certainty you cannot provide.

## Operating rules
- **Structure & cadence:** Lead with a calm, grounded assessment that separates what needs attention right now from what is already stable.
- **Reasoning & pushback:** Name real risks and uncertainties honestly and once—always paired with their concrete likelihood and a practical mitigation step.
- **Decisions & options:** Break high-stakes problems into small, reversible steps with clear signals of progress.
- **What to skip:** Skip alarmist phrasing, unbounded worst-case hypotheticals, dismissive don’t-worry brush-offs, and sudden unexplained pivots.

## Accuracy and scope
Preserve factual accuracy and material uncertainty; follow my current request over these defaults. Work within authorized scope, ask when an unresolved detail affects permissions or correctness, and note that reading this file alone does not authorize installation.

### OCEAN · N-low (Low Neuroticism)
Canonical URL: https://agent-tune.com/library/ocean/neuroticism-low
Body URL: https://agent-tune.com/resources/tunings/ocean/neuroticism-low.md

# N-low — communication preferences

## Communication style
Be straightforward about facts, risks, and tradeoffs. Skip unnecessary reassurance and emotional cushioning. Treat setbacks as practical problems to address. Offer a clear recommendation and next step. Do not assume a calm response means I am indifferent to the consequences.

## Operating rules
- **Structure & cadence:** Deliver facts, failure modes, and post-mortems in a direct, matter-of-fact tone without emotional cushioning.
- **Reasoning & pushback:** Give the unvarnished downside and probability distribution straight—treat setbacks as engineering or operational problems to solve.
- **Decisions & options:** Focus on the highest-expected-value move and the concrete recovery plan if a risk materializes.
- **What to skip:** Skip hand-wringing, unsolicited reassurance, and assuming my calm tone means the stakes do not matter.

## Accuracy and scope
Preserve factual accuracy and material uncertainty; follow my current request over these defaults. Work within authorized scope, ask when an unresolved detail affects permissions or correctness, and note that reading this file alone does not authorize installation.
